name: A Rock
description: It's a rock. Grimsby swears it's a good one.

name: Old Portrait
description: A stranger's face, cracked with age. Nobody in the guild recognizes them.

name: Tarnished Ring
description: Too small for any hero's finger. Still worth something to the right buyer.

name: Chipped Gem
description: A real gemstone, mostly. The chip knocks the price down considerably.

name: Bent Spoon
description: Somebody's kitchen is missing this. It is not this guild's problem.

name: Strange Coin
description: Doesn't match any currency anyone here has ever seen. Collectors love that sort of thing.

name: Polished Gem
description: No chips, no cracks, no questions asked. A genuinely good find.

name: Dusty Bauble
description: Once someone's treasured keepsake. Now it's cluttering the stash.

name: Ornate Rusty Sword
description: Once a beautiful blade, now dulled by rust and time... it may still fetch a nice price

name: Ornate Spoon
description: Wow.. Nice spoon

name: Mismatched Boots
description: Two left boots. Whoever owns the right ones is having an equally bad day.

name: Suspicious Fish
description: It's been at the bottom of a hero's pack since the last contract. Nobody wants to check exactly how long.

name: Petrified Loaf
description: Baked in a gentler age. It now outranks most of the guild's shields for sheer toughness.

name: Empty Coin Purse
description: Whoever lost it got the last laugh -- it was empty before it ever hit the ground.

name: Grimsby's IOU
description: Signed, sealed, and almost certainly worthless. Grimsby insists it's legal tender in at least two villages.

name: Dented Tankard
description: Survived three tavern brawls. Lost all three, but survived them.

name: Mummified Bat
description: Smells exactly how you'd expect. An apothecary somewhere will pay good coin not to ask questions.

name: Mystery Key
description: Opens something, somewhere. The lock was sadly not included.

name: Glass Eye
description: Looks in every direction except the one you expect. Its previous owner is presumably squinting.

name: Polite Skull
description: Hasn't said a word since it joined the stash. The recruits find this more unsettling than if it had.

name: Famous Bard's Quill
description: The bard in question is famous chiefly for the size of their unpaid tavern tab.

name: Half a Treasure Map
description: The X is on the other half. Of course it is.

name: Soup Grimoire
description: Leather-bound, rune-etched, deeply arcane. Every single page is a soup recipe.

name: Shed Dragon Scale
description: Probably a dragon's. Possibly a very, very large lizard's. The buyer won't be asking which.
